summary: Phase 147M implemented the Authority Evaluation Service integration per AESIC-001 v1.3 in a new pcae.aesic package (named to avoid a sys.modules-prefix collision with Phase 147H's own frozen pcae.authority_evaluation-prefixed cleanup logic; src/pcae/authority_evaluation/ itself remains byte-for-byte untouched). Implements: the Authority Evaluation Service (AES) as sole orchestrator; Decision Template Resolution; a minimal concrete filesystem AuthorityRegistry adapter; the two-stage evaluation lifecycle (evaluate_stage_1/evaluate_stage_2); the immutable Authority Evaluation Record (AER) with a two-tier compound-key (package_id, evaluation_id) primary store plus a tamper-evident, digest-verified canonical pointer index; Stage 1 handoff validation (closed four-reason taxonomy); Stage-1-evidence-equivalent idempotency and supersession; post-AER/pre-pointer recovery-by-retry; and the complete closed error taxonomy. Integrates narrowly and additively into Interactive Workflow (SessionApplicationService's new, optional authority_evaluation_service collaborator and evaluate_authority_stage_1/construct_readiness_package methods), Readiness (PublicationReadinessPackage's new, optional authority_evaluation_ref/citation_text field pair), and CHGR (build_publication_record populates authority_basis_claimed citation-only, verbatim, from citation_text when the pair is present; unchanged, disclosed-absent behavior otherwise) -- every touchpoint defaults to None/unconfigured, so every pre-existing caller is byte-for-byte unaffected. 59 new tests all passing; the existing 183 Phase 147G/147H tests and the full 4391-test fast_green baseline pass unchanged (zero regression). Complete 131-requirement traceability matrix included in docs/implementation/PHASE_147M_AUTHORITY_EVALUATION_INTEGRATION_IMPLEMENTATION.md. Overall Verdict: AUTHORITY EVALUATION INTEGRATION IMPLEMENTED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS (disclosed: no live multi-process concurrency stress test; authority_basis_claimed populated only for ELIGIBLE outcomes; the Decision Template on-disk store is this phase's own minimum-viable authoring convenience, not itself AESIC-001-governed). Recommends 147N (Authority Evaluation Integration Independent Implementation Verification), not itself an authorization.
tests_added_or_updated: Added tests/test_phase_147m_authority_evaluation_integration.py (59 tests: unit coverage of Stage1EvaluationResult/AuthorityEvaluationRecord/CanonicalPointer, Decision Template Resolution, the two-tier AER store, Stage 1/Stage 2 lifecycle idempotency and supersession, Stage 1 handoff validation, post-AER/pre-pointer recovery, security/tamper-detection, and Readiness/CHGR integration). The existing tests/test_phase_147g_authority_evaluation.py and tests/test_phase_147h_authority_evaluation_independent_verification.py suites, and the fast_green marker suite, were run to confirm zero regression.

no_go_confirmation: No amendment was made to AEM-001. No amendment was made to AEMIC-001 -- src/pcae/authority_evaluation/ remains byte-for-byte untouched. No amendment was made to IWC-001 -- only additive, optional, default-None fields were added to a model it governs, exactly as AESIC-REQ-059/109 themselves anticipate. No amendment was made to IWPC-001. No amendment was made to PEC-001. No amendment was made to CHGR-001 -- only citation-only, contract-anticipated population of an already-optional field. No architectural redesign occurred; every AESIC-001 section 4-9 component boundary is implemented exactly as written. No evaluation logic was moved into the Publication Coordinator; Coordinator.execute() never imports or calls AES, Resolution, or AuthorityRegistry. No Registry resolution was moved into the evaluator; evaluate() remains unmodified and free of I/O. No evaluation output was turned into an authorization; no field or method anywhere is treated as a permission or execution trigger. No confirmation gate was added or altered; Stage 1 remains advisory-only, never blocking a SessionState transition. No readiness gate was added; authority_evaluation_ref's mere presence is never treated as proof of readiness completeness. No publication gate was added; the Publication Coordinator's own idempotency and authorization machinery is unmodified. No execution gate was added; no code path in this diff branches execution on an evaluation outcome. No execution capability was enabled; src/pcae/runtime/** was not touched and pcae runtime inspect remains Observed / observe / unavailable, unchanged before and after this phase. No unrelated runtime plugin or CLI command was added. No scope expansion into broader governance redesign occurred; changes are limited to the AESIC-001 integration surface. No existing publication or artifact-integrity guarantee was weakened; AER and pointer immutability and digest verification are fail-closed throughout. No contract ambiguity was silently resolved through implementation choice; the implementation-level design choices this phase made beyond the contract's own text are explicitly disclosed in the implementation document's Limitations section.
